name: Accuracy International AX50
description: The Accuracy International AX50 is a high-precision, bolt-action.50 BMG anti-materiel rifle designed for military and police, It features a 27-inch barrel, folding stock, and modular KeySlot rail system. The rifle is known for consistent cold-shot performance, a 6-lug 60-degree bolt, and a 5-round magazine.

name: Barrett M82
description: The Barrett M82, also known as the M107 in U.S. military service, is a recoil-operated, semi-automatic anti-materiel rifle chambered in .50 BMG. It features a long barrel, large muzzle brake, and a distinctive box magazine. The M82 is designed for long-range engagements against vehicles, equipment, and personnel.

name: M4A1 Carbine
description: The M4A1 Carbine is a gas-operated, air-cooled, magazine-fed, shoulder-fired weapon that fires from the open-bolt position. It is a shorter and lighter variant of the M16 rifle, featuring a 14.5-inch barrel, collapsible stock, and Picatinny rail system. The M4A1 is widely used by military and law enforcement for its versatility and accuracy.

name: AK-47
description: The AK-47 is a gas-operated assault rifle designed by Mikhail Kalashnikov. It features a 7.62x39mm cartridge, 30-round magazine, and a rotating bolt mechanism. The AK-47 is known for its simplicity, reliability, and ease of maintenance, making it one of the most widely produced and used rifles in the world.

name: Glock 17
description: The Glock 17 is a polymer-framed, striker-fired semi-automatic pistol chambered in 9mm. It features a 17-round magazine capacity, a safe action trigger system, and a durable design. The Glock 17 is widely used by law enforcement and civilians for self-defense due to its reliability and ease of use.

name: Smith & Wesson Model 686
description: The Smith & Wesson Model 686 is a double-action revolver chambered in .357 Magnum. It features a stainless steel frame, adjustable rear sights, and a 6-round cylinder. The Model 686 is popular among law enforcement and civilian shooters for its accuracy, durability, and versatility.
